cases.sentence: Сказав это, Иисус пошел со Своими учениками на другую сторону ___, где был сад, в который они и вошли.
cases.explain: «Кедронской долины» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

cases.sentence: Отряд воинов, их командир и ___ арестовали Иисуса и связали Его.
cases.explain: «иудейские стражники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

cases.sentence: Было ___, и иудеи, опасаясь оскверниться, не вошли в здание, иначе они не смогли бы потом есть пасхальный ужин .
cases.explain: «раннее утро» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

cases.sentence: Было раннее утро, и иудеи, опасаясь оскверниться, не вошли в здание, иначе они не смогли бы потом есть ___ .
cases.explain: «пасхальный ужин» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
